exit_note: Trailed it properly for once. Nearly trimmed the last third on the 12th when it went vertical — glad I didn't, the MA10 close came three days later.
Bought the flag on day two of the pullback instead of waiting for the range to tighten. Stop was under the low, it just went.
No stop written down at the time — reconstructed from where I remember putting it, under the 6900 shelf.
